shortDescription: Credit ratings agency S&P on Friday revised Hungary's outlook to "stable" from "negative", saying strong institutional and fiscal frameworks would ensure a steady decline in budgetary deficits over the next two years.The agency affirmed the country's rating at "BBB-/A-3".
